objects.text:
Peak irradiance for a rectangular pulse:
Iₚₑₐₖ = F₀ / τ_L
objects.name: C2-E04 text 31

objects.text:
Example: F₀ = 1 J/cm², τ_L = 10 ns gives Iₚₑₐₖ =
10⁸ W/cm². The same energy in a shorter pulse
raises the peak.
objects.name: C2-E04 text 32

objects.text: Normalised so that f only says when the energy arrives, never how much: F(r) carries the amount.
objects.name: C2-E04 text 33

_audit.scientific_status: drawn from the equation and its stated numbers
